name: mse_grad
summary: dPred = (Pred - Target) * scale. scale defaults to 2/numel unless AttrBlob('MSEG') provides explicit scale. Supports f32 and f16; f16 uses half2(vec2) fastpath when numel even and pointers are 4B aligned.
contract: - All tensors must share the same dtype (variant-selected) and same shape
- Pred shape == Target shape == dPred shape
- numel = product(shape[0..rank-1]) must be > 0 (launcher treats <=0 as invalid)
- dPred[i] = (Pred[i] - Target[i]) * scale, flattened over numel
- default scale = 2.0 / numel unless provided by AttrBlob('MSEG')
- half2 path if numel even AND Pred/Target/dPred pointers are 4-byte aligned
abi: - only schema_id=='MSEG' is parsed; otherwise treated as 'no scale provided' and defaults apply
- variants set expected_attr_schema_id = 0 (dispatcher should allow passing schema 0 or MSEG; launcher parses MSEG when present)
notes: Kernels use grid-stride loops: i += blockDim.x * gridDim.x.
f16 half2 path uses __hsub2 + __hmul2 with scale broadcast to __half2 via __float2half2_rn(scale).
mse_grad_check_dt validates rank>=1, contiguous, same shape, and numel>0.
mse_grad_vec2_ok gates half2 on (numel even) + (4B alignment for all pointers).

variants.name: mse_grad_f32
variants.notes: Kernel: mse_grad_f32_kernel. Launch: threads=256, blocks=min(ceil(numel/256), 4096), grid-stride.

variants.name: mse_grad_f16
variants.notes: Scalar f16 kernel fallback: mse_grad_f16_kernel using __half2float / __float2half_rn, grid-stride.

variants.name: mse_grad_f16x2_half2
variants.notes: Fastpath: mse_grad_f16x2_kernel over numel2=numel/2 with __half2 ops, grid-stride.

experiments.title: f16 half2(vec2) fastpath
experiments.change: Add half2 kernel mse_grad_f16x2_kernel gated by even numel + 4B alignment.
experiments.why: Reduce instruction count and improve memory throughput for f16 elementwise grad.
experiments.hypothesis: Large tensors see higher GB/s vs scalar f16 kernel with identical results.
experiments.proof: Check selected variant + ncu dram throughput; compare gld/gst efficiency; validate correctness vs reference.
experiments.next: Try vectorized global loads (ld.global.v2) + unroll 2-4 to reduce loop overhead.

experiments.title: Precompute default scale on host side
experiments.change: Pass explicit MSEG(scale=2/numel) from planner to avoid device-side branching on attr presence.
experiments.why: Slightly simplifies launch path and keeps scale logic consistent across backends.
experiments.hypothesis: No perf change in kernel; less host logic divergence.
experiments.proof: Compare functional outputs and launch-time overhead (nsys).
experiments.next: Standardize loss-grad ops to always require explicit scale in AttrBlob.

measurements.notes: Elementwise grad: report latency + effective GB/s. Compare scalar vs half2.
